meta.title: Enable vm group append for tpc-ds
meta.body_summary: Update group append logic in runtime/vm to avoid unnecessary slice copies and refresh golden IR output for TPC-DS q63.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit VM slice-copy optimization with IR golden file update; self-merged by author in seconds with no review or benchmark evidence.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, the group append logic was adjusted to eliminate unnecessary slice copies, likely by using slice expressions that prevent reallocation. The golden IR output for TPC-DS query q63 was updated to reflect the new behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The IR output changes are a consequence of the VM modification; the primary performance change is in vm.go.
